job.title: Manager, Marketing Operations - Ad Tech Lead

match.reason: Complete duties and qualifications support assessment. Offline conversions, UTM governance, CRM routing and Marketo depth remain unverified; missing evidence does not prove absent capability or credentials.

evidence: Configured GA4 and Google Tag Manager measurement and built Looker Studio KPI dashboards for campaign pacing, website performance, inventory planning, and leadership decisions
responsibilities.reason: Paid measurement infrastructure is demonstrated; complete pixel-to-pipeline ownership is unverified.

responsibilities.requirement: own event tracking, conversion signals, and audience data flows across ad platforms
evidence: Implements GA4 events for product-list impressions, product selection and views, cart interactions, searches, filters, contact clicks, calls to action, and successful login or registration.
responsibilities.reason: Event implementation is demonstrated; cross-platform audience signal infrastructure is unverified.

responsibilities.requirement: manage and optimize Marketo paid program setup, scoring, audience segmentation, and integration with ad platforms
evidence: Installed Go High Level and trained employees on how to use it correctly.
responsibilities.reason: Automation-platform implementation transfers partially; Marketo scoring and integrations are unverified.
